newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India lazes ahead of SBI issue.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India lazes ahead of SBI issue.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) traded in a narrow range on Thursday ahead of the pricing of State Bank of India's (SBI) new issue.
"We are hearing that SBI has gone quite well," said a trader.

The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed down 0.31 points at 64.69 points, with the premium over the local market at 8.87 percent after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 31.03 points to 3,195.77.
SBI came too late for the London market, but traders said that if the issue was priced at a premium it could lift the market.
"It could give the market some confidence," said a trader.
"But it is not going to do a great deal. India is still stuck in a bit of a rut."
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.20 points at 69.49 , a premium of 28.64 percent over the local market with the local market closed for a holiday.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended up 1.05 points, 1.17 percent, at 91.02, a premium of 2.87 percent over the local market after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 73.34 points to 6,611.58.
